title: Tim Dooley Science & Mathematics — Master Research Index
status: canonical science navigation and programme layer
purpose: Navigate recovered Tim/book equations and statements, later mathematical formalizations, established scientific comparators, measurements, tests and unresolved archaeology as one coherent programme. Detailed equations live in typed ledgers; this root organizes questions, provenance, model families, maturity, measurements, failure conditions and canonical owners.
master_rule: Scientific usefulness rises when a model distinguishes concepts that prose conflated, connects latent variables to observations, competes with a baseline, survives unit/uncertainty checks and can return a negative result. Later mathematics must not be backdated into Tim's earlier statements.

equation_navigation.rule: Classify each expression as definition, identity, dynamical law, constraint, ansatz, measurement equation, statistical model, approximation or external comparator before drawing project conclusions.

Rhizome is a new biological/network comparator unless earlier Tim terminology is recovered.
